question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Final query: problems where condition count > solution count
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
condition_check AS (
    SELECT ss.name, ss.version, ss.step,
           CASE WHEN nss.max_non_stack_score < ss.stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as condition_met
    FROM stack_scores ss
    JOIN non_stack_scores nss ON ss.name = nss.name AND ss.version = nss.version AND ss.step = nss.step
),
condition_counts AS (
    SELECT name, SUM(condition_met) as condition_count
    FROM condition_check
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT cc.name
FROM condition_counts cc
JOIN solution_counts sc ON cc.name = sc.name
WHERE cc.condition_count > sc.solution_count
ORDER BY cc.name
